attempts.text:
**The window starts in a two-column spine.** Columns 0 to 1, `pncB` and `asnS`, are persistent, in 90 to 100% of chromosomes, and in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 99.8% of genes there and hesitates no more than 0.08 bits.

**A variable column follows at `ompF`**, carried by 88% of chromosomes, named in 97% of calls at 0.50 bits. Then columns 3 to 5, `aspC`, `gloC` and `mepK`, form a spine at 90%, named 99%, most hesitant at `aspC` with 0.25 bits. The `mukB`, `mukE`, `mukF` spine at columns 7 to 9 is the exception: named 55 to 97%, fewest at `mukE`, 55%.

**The middle spines are read easily.** Columns 13 to 14, `kdsB` and `ycaR`, are named 99.8%; column 17, `msbA`, 99% at 0.06 bits; columns 19 to 21, `ihfB`, `rpsA` and `cmk`, 97 to 99%. Between them sit variable columns such as `ycaQ` and `lpxK`, named 97 to 99%, and `ycaI`, named 92% at 0.41 bits.

**The long fork and variable stretch runs from column 28 to 79**, in a region of plasticity in 10 to 26% of calls, named 60 to 98%, fewest at column 71, 60%. Its variable columns carry `pflB` and `pflA` at 90%, down to `ycaK` at 50%, then `dmsC`, `dmsB`, `dmsA`, and the `art` and `pot` families near 70%. The most hesitant column is 60, `poxB`, 0.75 bits, in a region of plasticity in 20% of calls.

**The window ends at a fork**, column 79, `rimK`, persistent in 57% of chromosomes, with `nfsA` shell at 26% and `ybjC` persistent at 15%. Across the window the model names 91% of genes at 0.34 bits; inside a region of plasticity it names 65% against 95% outside, and hesitates 1.75 against 0.15 bits.

label: pncB
facts:
WINDOW: the pncB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor pncB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,760 to 2,839 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying pncB once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.34 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 36,795 calls, named 96%, 0.13 bits; shell 5,502 calls, named 73%, 1.22 bits; cloud 743 calls, named 17%, 4.29 bits. Outside an RGP 37,946 calls, named 95%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 5,094 calls, named 65%, 1.75 bits. Columns: 17 spine, 1 fork, 62 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.75 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (65% against 95%); 5,094 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 60 (poxB) 0.75 bits, RGP 20%; column 30 (ycaK) 0.73 bits, RGP 12%; column 56 (aqpZ) 0.72 bits, RGP 25%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 28-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 10-26%; the least: columns 0-1 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-1 (2 columns) spine: share 90-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: pncB, asnS. named 99.8%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.08 bits (column 0 (pncB)).
2. column 2 variable: RGP 0%. named 97%; 0.50 bits.
   2: ompF P 88%
3. columns 3-5 (3 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: aspC, gloC, mepK. named 99%; most hesitant at column 3 (aspC), 0.25 bits.
4. column 6 variable: RGP 1%. named 98%; 0.15 bits.
   6: ldtD P 90%
5. columns 7-9 (3 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 9%. Genes: mukB "chromosome partition protein MukB", mukE, mukF. named 55-97% (mean 69%), fewest named at column 8 (mukE), named 55%; most hesitant at column 7 (mukB), 0.24 bits.
6. columns 10-12 (3 columns) variable: RGP 8-9%. named 97-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 10, named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.11 bits (column 12).
   10: cmoM P 90%
   11: elyC P 90%
   12: ycbJ P 90% "YcbJ family phosphotransferase"
7. columns 13-14 (2 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 0.2-7%. Genes: kdsB, ycaR "protein YcaR". named 99.8%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.05 bits (column 13 (kdsB)).
8. columns 15-16 (2 columns) variable: RGP 0%. named 97-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 15, named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.14 bits (column 15).
   15: ycaQ P 88% "crosslink repair DNA glycosylase Yc…"
   16: lpxK P 90%
9. column 17 spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: msbA. named 99%; 0.06 bits.
10. column 18 variable: RGP 0.2%. named 92%; 0.41 bits.
   18: ycaI P 82% "DNA internalization-related compete…"
11. columns 19-21 (3 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 0.2%. Genes: ihfB, rpsA, cmk. named 97-99% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 19 (ihfB), named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.11 bits (column 19 (ihfB)).
12. column 22 variable: RGP 0.2%. named 98%; 0.08 bits.
   22: ycaL P 89%
13. column 23 spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 0.2%. Genes: aroA. named 97%; 0.13 bits.
14. columns 24-25 (2 columns) variable: RGP 0.2%. named 99%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.17 bits (column 25).
   24: serC P 90%
   25: ycaP P 89% "DUF421 domain-containing protein"
15. columns 26-27 (2 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 0.4-2%. Genes: ycaO "YcaO-like family protein", focA. named 99%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.08 bits (column 26 (ycaO)).
16. columns 28-79 (52 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 10-26%. named 60-98% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 71, named 60%; most hesitant at column 60, 0.75 bits.
   columns 28-78 variable, share 50-90%, 48 P, 3 S: pflB 90%, pflA "pyruvate formate lyase 1-activating…" 90%, ycaK 50%, ycaN "LysR substrate-binding domain-conta…" 58%, ycaM "amino acid permease" 77%, ycaD "MFS transporter" 90%, ycaC 88%, dmsC "dimethyl sulfoxide reductase anchor…" 88%, dmsB 88%, dmsA 85%, serS 83%, rarA 81%, lolA 81%, ftsK 80%, lrp 80%, trxB 80%, cydD 80%, cydC "heme ABC transporter ATP-binding pr…" 80%, aat 80%, infA 80%, clpA 75%, clpS "ATP-dependent Clp protease adapter…" 75%, yljB "protein YljB" 74%, cspD 75%, macB "ABC transporter permease" 73%, macA 74%, ybjX "VirK/YbjX family protein" 74%, ybjD "ATP-dependent endonuclease" 74%, aqpZ 70%, lysO 74%, hcp 73%, hcr 73%, poxB 73%, ltaE 73%, ybjT "NAD(P)H-binding protein" 72%, ybjS "NAD(P)-dependent oxidoreductase" 73%, amiD 72%, ybjQ "heavy metal-binding domain-containi…" 72%, ybjP "lipoprotein" 71%, artP 72%, artI "arginine ABC transporter substrate-…" 72%, artQ 71%, artM 71%, artJ 70%, rlmC 70%, ybjO "YbjO family protein" 71%, potI "ABC transporter permease subunit" 70%, potH 70%, potG 69%, potF 67%, ybjN "YbjN domain-containing protein" 64%
